fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Base units, granted by the engine rather than typed. Free goods bill at zero and never re-enter any scheme basis, so this quantity cannot help the cart cross the next slab.

fields.label: Unit
fields.description: The unit the quantity is expressed in for the dispatch note, so the warehouse picks pieces when the scheme meant pieces.

fields.label: Scheme
fields.description: Which scheme is paying for this. Nothing leaves a warehouse free without a scheme behind it to charge.

fields.label: Valuation Rate
fields.description: What one unit costs us, snapshotted at capture. The shop pays nothing; the cost is still real and lands somewhere.

fields.label: Valuation
fields.description: Quantity times valuation rate. This is what the scheme ledger accrues and what a distributor claim is eventually settled against.

fields.label: POSM
fields.description: Point-of-sale material - a branded shelf strip, a danglers pack, a sticker. It is dispatched and it costs money, but it is not a saleable SKU, so it must never be counted into sales volume or offtake.
